def q10_prac():
  K_p = symbols('K_p')
  G_s = 5 / ((s + 1) ** 2)
  G_PID_s = K_p * (1 + 5 / s + 0.2 * s)
  open_loop = G_s * G_PID_s
  char_eq = 1 + open_loop
  expanded = char_eq.expand().collect(s)
  char_poly = Poly(expanded, s)
  coeffs = char_poly.all_coeffs()

  return [solve(it, K_p) for i, it in enumerate(coeffs)]
